notes: Whispers now show up in the app. A new list keeps the whispers you were sent, so a message that arrived while you were away is still there when you get back, and you can turn the preview off if you would rather know a whisper arrived without seeing what it said. They reach every client too. If you run more than one, only the main one alerted you before and the rest stayed silent. A movement teleport that worked was being counted as a failure. Nothing closed it out when the teleport succeeded, so it sat waiting for a timeout, and after the second one the skill was held back for a moment. A teleport that works was getting slower the more you used it. It now closes the moment you land. Casting no longer throws away the walk it interrupted, so AUTO keeps the route it was on. A bond buff no longer re casts on every tick, because the effect lands on your bond target and the check for it was always looking at you. Auto store works on its own now, where before it needed auto sell switched on as well or the town trip never happened. And a ground hazard dodge now owns the controls while it steps you clear, instead of loot pickup, travel, auto loot, anti AFK and the toggle press all fighting it for the same frame. Two things now change what the bot does on its own. Necromancers, Summon Command is a command and not a summon, and is treated as one at last. Put it in your damage rotation and it will be cast at your target. Left in the buff list it is skipped without saying so, so move it across if that is where yours sits. And the bot can change channel when the server announces a restart even while AUTO is off, which it would not do before. That one is on by default, so turn it off if you would rather it stayed put. Update as usual, the app reinstalls itself cleanly.
